title: Repeated regex compilation
summary: Compiling regular expressions repeatedly instead of reusing compiled patterns.
rationale: Regex compilation is expensive compared with matching and can dominate repeated request paths.

detection.notes: Find Regex::new inside loops, handlers, parsers, or frequently called functions.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Hoist regex construction into LazyLock, once_cell, lazy_static, or initialization code.
remediation.tradeoffs: Dynamic patterns may require a bounded cache or explicit validation.
